verdict.rationale: Muse explicitly states it 'continues to work on a schedule and in response to relevant events, taking the next step and following up' (muse-docs-20), and monitors/follows up on tasks with notifications (muse-docs-24), with the Goals tab tracking ongoing work (muse-docs-5). This supports recurring/ongoing automation, but there's no detail on configuring recurrence intervals, workflow chaining, or independent verification of scheduling reliability — community evidence even notes control-plane timeouts under load (muse-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit recurrence/cron-style configuration details, multi-step workflow orchestration specifics, and independent hands-on confirmation that scheduled jobs run reliably.
